answers.valueEn: The entire rear section has been repainted. Rear bumper, rear right fender, rear left fender, trunk back, and trunk door were repainted. Replacement of trunk back, trunk door, trunk floor well, rear bumper, and rear lights. Replacement of rear left fender; there is a cut in the fender internals and cuts/welds in the rear chassis rails. Interior paint found in the rear fender and around the fender/sill area. Non-original sealant in the trunk interior. Non-original spot welds in the rear fender. Rear chassis rail straightening and welding in the bumper reinforcement/chassis rail area. Needs four new tires. Needs rear brake pads. Maintenance was done at the dealership up to 40k km. Repairs were carried out at the dealership.
